exact_statement: For every integer a>=0, ordinary fresh addressing with 2^a distinct data bits has H=2a and I=1+a/2. Under the explicit fixed code and queue definitions in REPORT.md, the repeated-label complete code has expected cost a(2+a/2), the optimal whole-set code and its singleton posterior cost 2a, and the source fractional pressure equals (7/2)a^2+(11/5)a. Their cost/I asymptotics are a+2+o(1), 4, and 7a+O(1), respectively. The literal one-root original queue and the conditioned singleton-posterior queue have common limiting cost/I=2+2G, with G defined by the integral in REPORT.md section 5 and 4<=2+2G<=4+(6/5)(1-1/(2 ln 2)). The coarse forest residual/I tends to 16/5; the complete coarse forest RHS/I tends to K_ref+16/5. All partition-posterior optima and unrestricted FEI are outside this claim.
